  • Spicy Tostada - Decent deal for a dollar and was spectacular when combined with the Mini Chicken Quesadilla. You'd open the Mini Chicken Quesadilla up flat, put the Spicy Tostada in it, and fold snap it back up and you'd have a beef, chicken, bean Double-Decker for cheaper than the Double-Decker. Taco Bell was NOT having that and discontinued the Mini Chicken Quesadilla about two weeks after viral videos started making the rounds about the "food hack" and re-tooled the Mini Chicken Quesadilla as a "melt", grilling the item shut and in an awkward way that made the previous combo impossible.
  • Triple Layer Nachos - I once ordered 3 of these and told them to just throw it into a Bell Grande container. It barely fit and I paid less than the Bell Grande which would've just added some tomato and a dollop of sour cream. Of course it had to go.
  • Spicy Potato Soft Taco - See below.
  • Cheesy Fiesta Potatoes - So the great potato experiment has failed. I wonder if this means retooling the breakfast menu won't be long after.

Always woefully underfilled and probably the biggest rip-off on the menu as it kept climbing in price while looking like a Cheese Roll-Up, grilled with a little meat.
  • Chips & Dips - So no longer can have chips and nacho cheese as a replacement side item instead of Cinnamon Twists. Yeah, okay. They really want to push those Cinnamon Twists. Margin on them must be fucking huge.
  • Mini Skillet Bowl. - Didn't know this was a thing.
  • Quesarito will only be available by ordering through the restaurant’s website or app - Also stupid expensive for what you get. It'd be one thing if the quesadilla layer also had a meat option but it didn't. Between this or a XXL Grilled Stuft you would always want the Grilled Stuft which is why they had to kill it, too.
  • The updated menu will include the $5 Grande Nachos Box -- oh boy the promo item you ran two months out of every quarter is a permanent item now but without a drink? oh golly oh gee what a fucking game changer
  • and the Beef Burrito - we'll see what this actually winds up being.
